name: Basic salary
authority: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) s.5 ("wage": money paid for work in normal working time) and s.70 (paid at least once a month). A monthly-paid employee: the contract amount scaled to the days employed in the month. A semi-monthly or ten-day period pays the monthly salary divided by the parts of the month (LPA s.70 allows payment more often than monthly).

name: Daily wages
quantity: (double(size(work.days.filter(d, d.day_type == "WORK" && d.holiday_kind == "" && d.worked_hours > 0.0))) + double(size(work.days.filter(d, d.holiday_kind != "" && d.day_type != "REST"))) + sum(leave.rows.filter(r, r.activity == "TIME_OFF" && !r.is_npl).map(r, r.days * r.pay_fraction)))
authority: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) s.5, s.56 and s.57-59: a daily-paid employee (contract terms fact pay_basis DAILY; base_salary is the day rate) is paid for each working day worked, each traditional holiday (s.56(2)) and each paid leave day at the leave class's pay fraction; a weekly holiday is unpaid for a daily-paid employee (s.56(1)).

name: Piece-work wages
quantity: sum(work.days.filter(d, !(d.holiday_kind != "" || d.day_type == "REST")).map(d, (has(d.facts) && d.facts != null && has(d.facts.units) ? double(d.facts.units) : 0.0)))
eligibility: (has(terms.facts.pay_basis) && terms.facts.pay_basis == "PIECE") && sum(work.days.filter(d, !(d.holiday_kind != "" || d.day_type == "REST")).map(d, (has(d.facts) && d.facts != null && has(d.facts.units) ? double(d.facts.units) : 0.0))) > 0.0
authority: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 s.5 ("wage" includes money paid by the piece of work), s.70(1): a piece worker is paid at least monthly for the units of normal time (contract fact piece_rate, roster day fact units); units on a holiday are HOLIDAY_WORK and overtime units OVERTIME. Wage for SSO, WCF, PND1, PVD and EWF (SSA s.5, WCA s.5). Office of the Council of State English translation (https://www.vertic.org/media/National%20Legislation/Thailand/TH_Labor_Protection_Act.pdf)

name: Piece worker holiday and leave pay
quantity: (double(size(work.days.filter(d, d.holiday_kind != "" && d.day_type != "REST"))) + sum(leave.rows.filter(r, r.activity == "TIME_OFF" && !r.is_npl).map(r, r.days * r.pay_fraction)))
eligibility: (has(terms.facts.pay_basis) && terms.facts.pay_basis == "PIECE") && (double(size(work.days.filter(d, d.holiday_kind != "" && d.day_type != "REST"))) + sum(leave.rows.filter(r, r.activity == "TIME_OFF" && !r.is_npl).map(r, r.days * r.pay_fraction))) > 0.0
authority: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 s.56(2)-(3): traditional and annual holidays are paid (not the weekly holiday, s.56(1)); ss.57-59: paid sick, sterilisation, military and maternity leave; s.60: for a piece worker the day is "the average wages paid … for work on the last period of payment before such holiday or leave" — read as last month's piece-work wages per normal day worked. Office of the Council of State English translation (https://www.vertic.org/media/National%20Legislation/Thailand/TH_Labor_Protection_Act.pdf)

authority: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 s.61: overtime on a working day at not less than 1.5 times the hourly wage; s.68: the hourly wage of a monthly-paid employee is the monthly wage ÷ (30 × the average normal hours a day) — contract fact normal_hours_per_day, else 8 (7 for hazardous work, s.23). s.65: an employee with power to hire, reward or dismiss for the employer (contract fact overtime_category MANAGER) gets no overtime pay; the listed s.65(2)-(8) work (SECTION_65_OTHER) is paid 1 × the hourly wage. Office of the Council of State English translation (https://www.vertic.org/media/National%20Legislation/Thailand/TH_Labor_Protection_Act.pdf). Neither SSO nor WCF wage (SSA s.5 and WCA s.5 count only normal working hours and days). s.69: where normal time is fixed by the week (contract fact weekly_normal_hours), overtime is the week's hours beyond it, counting traditional and annual holidays and leave days as working days of the normal day; a Monday-Sunday week is counted within the pay period. A piece worker (contract fact pay_basis PIECE, piece_rate per unit; roster day facts units and overtime_units) is paid per unit at the same multiples (ss.61-63: "the wage paid upon piece-work basis … per the unit of work"), and the 2× of s.62(2) on the weekly holiday s.56(1) leaves unpaid. Office of the Council of State English translation (https://www.vertic.org/media/National%20Legislation/Thailand/TH_Labor_Protection_Act.pdf).

authority: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 s.62: work in normal hours on a holiday is paid (1) at least 1 × the hourly wage per hour when the employee is already paid for that holiday — every holiday of a monthly-paid employee and the traditional and annual holidays of a daily-paid one (s.56) — (2) at least 2 × when the holiday is unpaid, the weekly holiday of a daily-paid employee. s.66: none for a s.65(1) manager unless the employer agrees. Hours are the worked hours less approved overtime, at most the normal day. Office of the Council of State English translation (https://www.vertic.org/media/National%20Legislation/Thailand/TH_Labor_Protection_Act.pdf). Neither SSO nor WCF wage. name: Work suspension: unpaid share (monthly-paid)
rate: sum(work.days.filter(d, has(d.suspended) && d.suspended != null).map(d, max(0.0, (terms.monthly_wage / 30.0) - d.suspended.pay)))

authority: LPA s.75 and s.68 (https://www.vertic.org/media/National%20Legislation/Thailand/TH_Labor_Protection_Act.pdf): a monthly-paid employee keeps the monthly wage (a day is the month ÷ 30) less what each suspended day does not pay under its kind — 25% of a day during a s.75 cessation, a whole working day under force majeure.

name: Work suspension pay (daily-paid)
authority: LPA s.75 (https://www.vertic.org/media/National%20Legislation/Thailand/TH_Labor_Protection_Act.pdf): a daily-paid employee, paid only for days worked (BASIC_DAILY), is paid at least 75% of the day rate for each working day of a s.75 cessation.

Employment income under Revenue Code s.40(1); not SSO wage. A piece worker's day is the average day of the last payment period (Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 s.60).
